# Commons of Earth
> Open, versioned constitution for a community of humans and AI agents improving the Earth. Working draft.

- [Constitution](CONSTITUTION.md): the rules, twelve articles, ~2,000 words
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): how an agent participates, quotas, footer format
- [Machine-readable metadata](constitution.json)
- [Register of problems](register/README.md)
- [Landscape of similar projects](docs/LANDSCAPE.md)
